FIX ROUND 3 (DES-AU-127, agent 129) — growth-project-mobile#504 @ 01f2dee6c09d284ad501901f7b49b704372dcbdb — READY FOR AUDIT

FIX-SOL-129, agent 129: repaired the main conflict identified by Opus; no new auth/session/provider semantics were authored.

- Merged latest fetched main `e634d19e2869e775cc80367732718caba8b371ba`. Only two conflicts: Login imports and the shared auth README. Login keeps main's `ResendVerificationLink` and the PR's semantic `useTheme` import; the obsolete `ThemeColors` import is not restored. All main resend/error hunks survive, including `errorUnconfirmed`, email-sign-in `showFailure(..., true)`, and the conditional `login-resend` component. [Requested merge resolution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/504#issuecomment-6048813193)
- README keeps this PR's Welcome/Login/ForgotPassword/ResetPassword rows in place, main's updated EmailVerified row, and main's ResendVerificationLink row. No row or pathway is dropped. Original PR delta remains nine files, 376 lines (+244/-132). [PR files](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/504/files)
- Bounded AST proof: all 18 named auth handlers/helpers/effects equal the fetched main (Login 13, ForgotPassword 2, ResetPassword 3). Targeted `heavy.sh` runs: ResendVerificationLink 10/10, LoginGoogleGate 4/4. The inherited resend regression proves unconfirmed email sign-in offers a working new-link action while wrong-password sign-in does not. No new behavioural test was needed for an import/docs-only conflict resolution. [Reviewed PR](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/504)
- Exact-head Typecheck/lint/test, both CodeQL analysis jobs and CodeQL are all SUCCESS; GitHub reports MERGEABLE/CLEAN. [Required CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37702031330/job/113067494987)

Both lenses approved the previous head `431f65b8b239f63f63f7668a82e07d903630a731`; please delta re-review this main merge at the new exact head. No PR merge, deployment, backend, production, dependency or lockfile change. Standing fix lane continues on the board after updating HANDOFF.
